title: Loopscale Curation (Exponent strategy-vaults program) — unprivileged extraction
closed_reasons: Role checks present and enforced in the deployed binary (fresh-signer simulateTransaction returns UnauthorizedRole 6005 for sentinel_set_vault_flags and manage_vault_settings; InvalidPriceManager 6068 for manage_prices)
initialize_prices is no longer permissionless (UnauthorizedRole 6005) — ADV-08/09 price-registry takeover closed
Vault creation is allowlist-gated (ELF marker 'Invalid vault creator' / 'YVault creators capacity exceeded') — ADV-26 closed
Deployed program upgraded 2026-10-14, after all three audits (Adevar 2026-04-13, Adevar ext 2026-05-25, OtterSec 2026-05-29); all findings Resolved except a few acknowledged LOW
Deposit/withdraw only move the caller's own funds (fresh signer has no token account / withdrawal account)
key_facts: Fresh-signer probes: UnauthorizedRole 6005 (sentinel, manage_vault_settings, initialize_prices), InvalidPriceManager 6068 (manage_prices)
Deployed ELF contains audit-fix markers: 'Cannot remove the last price manager', 'Invalid vault creator', 'Live wrapper setup only supports additive strategy position changes'
refresh_aum and update_price are permissionless cranks by design (oracle-validated, TWAP-divergence bounded)
caveats: Vaults program source is private; deployed-vs-audit comparison is by upgrade date + string markers, not a byte-level diff
No LiteSVM replay — reconstructing the vault account graph plus Loopscale/Kamino CPI accounts was out of budget; read-only simulateTransaction on live state was used instead
P category = the Loopscale curator/manager key could drive manager-gated actions (by design; not external)
Acknowledged LOW DoS items remain (pre-funded-PDA seed DoS; zero-mint for allowlisted vault creators)
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the $7.49M of Loopscale-curated Exponent vaults: every value-moving instruction is role-gated and enforced in the post-audit deployed binary, verified by fresh-signer simulateTransaction on live state.
